finding: No Sept 2020 protest onset was found in date-bounded and continuity searches. Cultural sector closure since the pandemic began is issue background, not protest onset. Search surfaced a planned national cultural demonstration in Jan 2021; it is a later planned action and does not establish continuity from Oct 18.

PANA reports that organizers threatened a possible weeklong work stoppage later if occupancy-cap demands were not addressed. The reporting does not establish that it occurred in November or December. Searches found no completed follow-up strike.
